name: sh-video-editor
description: SH Video Editor: CapCut 식 영상·오디오 편집기. Electron+React 데스크톱과 WASM 웹이 같은 화면(packages/editor)과 같은 Rust 엔진(packages/engine)을 쓴다
author: 이성현

scripts.build:engine: npm run build:engine:node && npm run build:engine:wasm
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p packages/editor/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/engine/tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:unit && npm run test:engine
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: npm run build -w apps/desktop && xvfb-run -a playwright test -c apps/desktop/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e:web && npm run test:e2e:desktop
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
